caption: Vor Frue, Assens
composition: A red-brick basilica and an octagonal copper spire · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Vor Frue in Assens is a red-brick Gothic basilica in bare brick, with dark slate roofs and a west tower that is square below and octagonal above, finished with a copper spire. The square is empty. The afternoon is overcast, about 17.1°C.9°C. An overcast sky softens the afternoon light. The harbour basin is not in this frame.
